# Apply Step 3: Independent Review

Before any Opt work, complete ordinary goals and Required Corrections, run the required tests, then commit the implementation to be reviewed. Supply only changeName, the actual checkout's absolute projectRoot, reviewKind, and any selected non-conflicting quality dimensions. Do not pass reviewId, scope, changeDir or a target commit. The Reviewer derives changeDir and commit from its checkout, reads baseCommit from .apply-isolation.json, and independently reviews committed HEAD. Each delegated full-change dimension covers the whole cumulative Change; dimensions may be reviewed in parallel when assignments do not conflict. Pi Reviewers run in the background so environment extensions are available.

Wait for every required Reviewer result before consolidation. A delegation/input error or HEAD movement is not an implementation FAIL: correct the assignment or commit state and delegate again. Do not record PASS if a required dimension is missing, invalid, unresolved or failed. Missing or invalid results require re-delegation; genuine implementation failures must be recorded as FAIL. Consolidate all required dimension results into one opinion with reviewKind: full-change, the common inspected commit, PASS only when all required dimensions pass, a concise summary, and merged findings. Record exactly that one opinion through the generated v5 schema in .xirang/references/xirang-quality-cli.md. If it fails, address Required Corrections, commit the correction and obtain a new independent Review of that commit.

After Opt, obtain independent full-change or incremental Review of all retained changes not yet reviewed before Seal. Choose scope from cumulative changes and affected behavior; risk does not waive Review. You may review early or after several batches, and further changes require renewed Review. A confirmed pre-existing Change defect missed by full-change Review must be repaired and receive a supplemental Review of the repair and impact. Record each consolidated opinion against the commit actually reviewed. A no-change delivery does not waive earlier Review obligations; do not represent your own judgment as Reviewer PASS. Reviewer tests are evidence to judge, not a requirement to rerun them.
